notes: Ethereum mainnet: one application deployment, GoblinNFT at index 0, from accepted source commit fdb50e17659ad331d4f74921677bc110f3e4fec0 without source changes. Build uses the repository foundry.toml: solc 0.8.26, optimizer enabled with 200 runs, Cancun, via_ir false, bytecode_hash none. The sole constructor argument is the static project wallet address 0xA7e99BB7155D7477E0C838E201b16E62B9c0b5Ac that the approved brief states as constructor word [0]; it becomes the Ownable owner, not the factory and not a protocol address. GoblinArt is internal and compiled into GoblinNFT. Mint opens on deployment: 10,000 live Goblins, 0.001 ETH each, maximum 20 mints per wallet. Holders can burn for the full mint price before sellout, during each seven-day target review, and from 90 days after sellout until release. Every setLaunchTargets call restarts review. Once sold out and review has ended, release() credits the remaining mint escrow 50/40/10 to the three destinations for collection through claimRelease(). A review completed before sellout permits release from the sellout block; this is accepted. The owner chooses contract destinations and may transfer ownership before release; code-size checks do not establish destination safety. These accepted powers remain subject to target review, and renunciation is available after release. Revenue may be deposited at any time and claimed per token by its current holder; transfers carry unpaid revenue. Rounding dust, zero-supply deposits and refunded tokens' unclaimed revenue are retained and logged. On-chain art and metadata logic are fixed. The accepted informational findings remain unchanged.
